## ITPageData type

Page routing data configuration.

**Signature:**

```typescript
type ITPageData<T extends any[] = any[]> = {
    name: string;
    callback: (...payloads: T) => string;
    intentText: string;
    intentTextCommand: string;
    _positionPayloadText: number;
    intentCallback: string;
};
```

## Remarks

Contains all routing metadata and handlers for a page in the Gramstax framework. This type defines the internal structure used by the routing system to match incoming updates to the appropriate page handlers.
